description: Answers: what do Orb Studio's radars (news) or crypto passport (crypto) show right now, as one small signed record? topic=news gives the top headlines with their word-rule passports (status, checkability, confidence, which checks fired) and the radar levels; topic=crypto gives the crypto market regime (calm / nervous / storm) and ECB EUR/USD, never a trade direction. Free, no key. The record has a passport_id and an Ed25519 signature that shows it is unchanged and was issued by Orb Studio (check it at /api/v1/agents/witness/<passport_id>); the signature does not show the news is true.
name: get_brief
title: Signed brief of Orb Studio radars or the crypto passport for the last 30 minutes
